trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Detected the problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- **Identified recovery target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release previously healthy in production.
- **Rolled back:** Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions via rollback.
- **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy with error rate back down to ~0.2%.
- **Opened a SEV2 incident:** INC-0001 is open, titled "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0," summarizing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was a previously healthy production release. The on-call engineer now has full context to investigate what broke in v2.3.1.
